title: Perceived Stress Scale, 10-item
description: 10 items about feelings and thoughts during the last month, each rated 0–4.

citation.text: Cohen S, Kamarck T, Mermelstein R (1983). A global measure of perceived stress. Journal of Health and Social Behavior 24(4):385–396.

scoring.text: Sum of the 10 items (0–40) after reversing the positively stated items 4, 5, 7 and 8. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
